clips.title: The story
paras: Agama'gor stands north of the road from Camp Taurajo toward Mulgore. Bristleback quilboar hold this encampment in the southern Barrens, keeping pressure on the nearby Horde outpost.

Agama'gor is a Bristleback stronghold in the southern Barrens. Its huts, brambles, and crude totems lie close to Camp Taurajo. The quilboar threaten travelers moving between the Barrens and Mulgore’s grassy hills, and Horde scouts and hunters fight to contain them.

Bristleback quilboar in Agama'gor carry crimson stones called Blood Shards. Mangletooth, an exiled quilboar held captive at Camp Taurajo, seeks these stones because of ancient beliefs about Agamaggan’s sacred essence. Horde adventurers raid the encampment for shards and trade them to Mangletooth for tribal charms.
